cause: The two figures are close (+0.7%) but measure different things. The report's tax expenditure is New York State personal income tax liability alone, from a study file of full-year resident, part-year resident and nonresident returns. The dashboard's figure is the net budget effect for New York resident households: the change in federal income tax plus state income tax minus household benefits (total_budgetary_impact in scripts/modal_cpid_endpoint.py at 0525a73). Its state income tax includes New York City income tax (state_income_tax_before_refundable_credits lists nyc_income_tax_before_refundable_credits; nyc_taxable_income adds ny_taxable_income), which applies to households the dataset places in the five NYC counties (in_nyc reads county_str); whether the June state file placed households in those counties is not recorded. The run did not save the state-only change (state_tax_change), so the components cannot be separated from results.json.
